Water Pulse (Japanese: みずのはどう Water Pulse) is a damage-dealing Water-type move introduced in Generation III. It was TM03 in Generations III and IV and in Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl. It is TM011 in Generation IX.

Effect

Water Pulse inflicts damage and has a 20% chance of confusing the target. It can hit non-adjacent opponents in Triple Battles.

Water Pulse's power is increased by 50% when used by Pokémon with the Ability Mega Launcher.

Water Pulse can be used as the second move of a Pokémon Contest combination, with the user gaining 3 bonus appeal points if Rain Dance was used in the previous turn.

Generation VIII

Pokémon Legends: Arceus

Water Pulse can no longer confuse the target. Instead, it bypasses accuracy and evasion checks to always hit.

In other games

Pokémon Mystery Dungeon series

In Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team, Water Pulse has 12 base power, 12 PP and 88% accuracy. The attack travels up to 10 tiles away and hits the first Pokémon it encounters, ally or enemy, possibly inflicting confusion.

In Explorers of Time, Darkness and Sky, the move's PP has been decreased to 12, and its accuracy to 83.6%.

Pokémon UNITE

In Pokémon UNITE, Water Pulse is Azumarill's first move. It is obtained by reaching level 7 and upgrading Bubble into it instead of Play Rough. The move shoots a pulsing blast of water in front of the user. When the blast of water hits an enemy, decrease their movement speed for 2s and deal damage to all enemies in an area of effect around the initial target. The blast of water then automatically bounces to another target if one is available. Including the first target, the blast of water can bounce between up to three targets consecutively, and each hit behaves in the same way as the first. While the blast of water is traveling, the user can perform a short rolling dash in a designated direction. At level 13, the maximum number of targets that the blast of water can bounce between is increased by 2.

Description

Games Description

Whiscash Whiscash puts its whiskers in the air and a ball of water forms in between them. It puts the ball down and shoots the ball at the opponent.
Nero Whiscash and Ash None
Lairon Lairon's eyes glow blue and then pulses appear under the opponent. A geyser then shoots out of the ground under the opponent.
Savannah's Lairon A Fan with a Plan None
Huntail Huntail opens its mouth and a blue ball forms in front of it. It then fires the ball at the opponent.
Keith's Huntail The Evolutionary War None
Gorebyss Gorebyss lowers its head and a blue ball forms on its forehead. It then fires the ball at the opponent.
Nancy's Gorebyss The Evolutionary War None
Luvdisc Luvdisc fires a ball of water from its mouth at the opponent.
Juan's Luvdisc The Great Eight Fate! None
Linoone Linoone creates a huge blue ball of energy in between its hands. It then throws it to the ground, making water hit the foe and sending it back. Sometimes, the move confuses the opponent, making them have bruise-like marks around their eyes when they are.
Kimmy Shoney's Tokin Showdown At Linoone None
Wailord Wailord opens its mouth and creates a blue energy ball in its mouth. It then fires the energy ball at the opponent.
Robin's Wailord Island Time None
Persian Persian creates a blue ball of water in front of its mouth. Persian then slams the ball into the ground, and waves of water come out from around its body.
Vivica's Persian Saved by the Beldum None
A wild Persian Genesect and the Legend Awakened None
Articuno Articuno releases a blue ball of energy from its mouth at the opponent. When the attack hits the opponent, the ball turns into water.
Noland's Articuno The Symbol Life None
Swampert Swampert's tailfin glows orange and it gathers water vapor from the air above its tail. A geyser then fires from the water above Swampert's tailfin at the opponent and sucks it up into a water tornado.
Tucker's Swampert Tactics Theatrics!! None
Poliwag Poliwag fires a blue ball of energy from its mouth at the opponent. The ball glides across a stream of water that is created under the ball.
Hiroshi's Poliwag Curbing the Crimson Tide! None
Aggron Aggron creates a blue ball of energy in between its three horns, then launches the ball into the ground, creating a wave of water and hitting the opponent.
James's Aggron Grating Spaces! None
Absol Absol's body becomes outlined in blue and it releases a large water tornado around its body, or Absol's body becomes outlined in blue and it releases a huge wave at the opponent.
Drew's Absol Thinning the Hoard! None
Shellos Shellos opens its mouth and a blue ball of energy appears in front of it. It then fires a spiraling stream of water from the ball at the opponent.
Zoey's Shellos Dawn's Early Night! None
Buizel Buizel puts its hands together and forms a blue ball. It then throws the ball at the floor and it glides on the ground across a stream of water at the opponent, hitting it; or, Buizel throws the ball at the ground and it turns into a huge wave of water, with the wave going and hitting the opponent. On occasion, this will confuse the opponent.
Ash's Buizel A Triple Fighting Chance! None
Slowking Slowking raises its hands and a blue ball of energy forms in between them. Slowking then throws the ball at the opponent.
Conway's Slowking Up Close and Personable! None
Milotic A large ring of water appears around Milotic's body and expands, or Milotic releases a stream of water with rings surrounding it at the opponent.
Palmer's Milotic Arceus and the Jewel of Life None
Oleana's Milotic Sword and Shield... The Legends Awaken! None
Gastrodon All three of Gastrodon's eyes glow light blue, and a light blue orb of energy appears in front of its mouth. It then fires the orb at the opponent.
Zoey's Gastrodon Last Call—First Round! None
Gastrodon A light blue orb of energy appears in front of Gastrodon's third eye and it fires the orb at the opponent. When the orb hits it, it explodes in the form of water.
Paul's Gastrodon Familiarity Breeds Strategy! None
Frillish Frillish puts its tentacles in front of its body and forms a light blue ball of energy in between them. It then pushes the ball with its tentacles, slightly making it smaller. It then throws the orb at the opponent. When the ball hits the opponent, it expands and surrounds the opponent in a large orb of water. The water then swirls around from all sides, causing the water to explode. On occasion, this will confuse the opponent.
Trip's Frillish A Rival Battle for Club Champ! None
Dewott Dewott holds out both of its arms in the shape of a 'T' and opens its mouth. A light blue orb of energy appears in front of Dewott's mouth and it fires it at the opponent. When the orb hits the opponent, it expands and surrounds the opponent in a large orb of water. The orb then floats into the air and the water then starts to swirl around from all sides, causing the water to explode.
Burgundy's Dewott A Connoisseur's Revenge! None
Glalie A light blue orb of energy appears in front of Glalie's mouth and it fires it at the opponent. When the orb hits the opponent, it expands and surrounds the opponent in a large orb of water. The orb then floats into the air and the water then starts to swirl around from all sides, causing the water to explode.
Morana's Glalie Survival of the Striaton Gym! None
Froakie Froakie creates a blue sphere of energy from in between its hands. It then fires the sphere at the opponent, which explodes into a wave of water.
Ash's Froakie Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin! None
Ash's Froakie Dream a Little Dream from Me! In a dream
Frogadier Frogadier creates a blue sphere of energy from in between its hands or it creates a blue sphere of energy in front of each of its hands. It then fires the spheres at the opponent, which explodes into a wave of water.
Sanpei's Frogadier A Rush of Ninja Wisdom None
Ash's Frogadier Thawing an Icy Panic! None
Blastoise Blastoise fires a blast of water at the opponent from each of its cannons, one after the other.
Gary's Blastoise Advice to Goh! None


  • In the preview for the unaired AG101, a Whiscash is seen using Water Pulse.
  • In Analysis Versus Passion!, Sawyer told his Clawitzer to use Water Pulse, but it was unable to execute the move before Ash's Pikachu attacked it with Electro Ball.

Trivia

  • From Generation III onwards, Secret Power has the animation of Water Pulse if used on water.
  • Water Pulse is the only Water-type move capable of inflicting confusion.
